blocks.html: Radiation machines or particle accelerators, linear accelerators, cyclotrons, synchrotons, betatrons, or bevatrons shall be located only in buildings of Type I or II construction; however, this requirement shall not apply to conventional medical, dental, research, or industrial x-ray machines of less than one million-volt capacity.
